'''U9-C4''', also known simply as '''Ceefor''', was a [[Gender/Legends|masculine]] [[R5-series astromech droid]] member of [[D-Squad/Legends|D-Squad]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He belonged to [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Thongla Jur/Legends|Thongla Jur]].

{{Droid-stub}}

==Biography==
Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], the squad, now led by [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Meebur Gascon/Legends|Meebur Gascon]], was given the task of infiltrating a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] ship and stealing a decoding module.

When the squad went to see the [[Parwan/Legends|Parwan]] doctor [[Gubacher/Legends|Gubacher]], [[Gender/Legends|he]] gave U9-C4 the modification that allowed him to use a powerful [[Laser cutter/Legends|laser cutter]], which would be used several times throughout the mission to cut open doors and later destroy several [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. However, the laser cutter had a large amount of recoil and U9-C4 had to lock himself in position otherwise the recoil would launch him backward.

==Behind the scenes==
In [[Dave Filoni]]'s sketch of D-Squad, U9-C4 was depicted as an [[R6-series astromech droid]].<ref name="Jedi Temple Archives">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season Five|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season Five]]</ref>
